name: Lilac on the Bloody Thorn Path
source:
Join the crew of the MBF Sprite’s Grove, privateers for the Free Planets of Macrola, as they race against a wicked trio of hostile Imperial Coalition veterans for an legendary artifact of a long-dead advanced civilization. Of course, that’s if everyone can stay on task. The Argasyl System has its means of exposing the secrets and sadistic tendencies of those who step foot on its shores, and no once-hardened heart shall go unturned.

[From [url=https://dianerds.itch.io/lilac-on-the-bloody-thorn-path]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
加入MBF Sprite’s Grove的船员队伍，他们是马克罗拉自由行星的私掠船，与邪恶的三人敌对帝国联盟老兵争夺一个早已消亡的先进文明的传奇神器。当然，前提是每个人都能坚持完成任务。阿加西尔星系有其手段来揭露那些踏上其海岸的人的秘密和虐待狂倾向，任何曾经坚硬的心都不会放过。

[来自[url=https://dianerds.itch.io/lilac-on-the-bloody-thorn-path]itch.io[/url]]
